title: Digestion of Protein
page_title: Protein Digestion - IGCSE Biology Revision Notes

blocks.name: Digestion of protein: Extended
blocks.definition:
Describe the digestion of protein by proteases in the digestive system:
(a) pepsin breaks down protein in the acidic conditions of the stomach
(b) trypsin breaks down protein in the alkaline conditions of the small intestine

blocks.md: - Proteases are a group of **enzymes that break down proteins into amino acids** in the stomach and small intestine (with the enzymes in the small intestine having been produced in the pancreas)

blocks.alt: Diagram showing protease enzymes breaking a chain-like protein molecule into separate amino acid molecules.
blocks.caption: The digestion of proteins

blocks.md:
- Protein digestion takes place in the stomach and duodenum with two main enzymes produced:

  - **pepsin** is produced in the **stomach and breaks down protein in acidic conditions**
  - **trypsin** is produced in the **pancreas** and secreted into the **duodenum** where it breaks down protein in** alkaline conditions**
